verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Auto Loader (Lakeflow) as a single, documented mechanism to incrementally load files that arrive in cloud object storage as part of an ETL pipeline, and a general ingestion connectors page for choosing a source/format, which broadly satisfies the story. However, the evidence never explicitly enumerates CSV, JSON, and Parquet support in one command syntax (e.g., no COPY INTO example, no explicit format list), so the exact 'single documented command for these three formats' claim is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: explicit documentation showing a single command (like COPY INTO or Auto Loader syntax) with CSV/JSON/Parquet all listed as supported formats, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific bulk-load flow.
